notes.title: HotFix 1
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Added hotkeys to open quests and the shop.
 "Free residents" renamed to "Unemployed residents."
 Removed the possibility of two similar quests appearing simultaneously.
 Added a sound effect when the player tries to build on an invalid tile.
 Added destroyed variations for the meadow and beach.


Bug Fixes:

 The number "0" always appeared above the casino.
 The fire station protected against meteor strikes.
 New quests were generated when restarting the tutorial.
 Cars on an empty beach appeared to float above the road.
 Cars on the beach could turn incorrectly while moving.
